{{Top}}
'''Assault shuttles''' were a type of armed [[shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] for landing infantry units. An assault shuttle would typically contain one [[platoon/Legends|platoon]] consisting of forty [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. 

''[[New Hope]]'', the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[flagship/Legends|flagship]], had assault shuttles in its [[hangar/Legends|hangar]].<ref name="soldier">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> [[Vengeance-class dreadnought|''Vengeance''-class dreadnoughts]] also had complements of assault shuttles.<ref name="rebel" />

Assault shuttles were used by [[Imperial Special Operations]] [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial commandos]] during the [[Subjugation of Sulon]].<ref name="soldier" />

Years later, [[Boc Aseca]] led a team of Imperial commandos boarding [[Duno Dree's transport]], and capturing [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]] with his team.<ref name="rebel">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

[[Sariss]], [[Yun]] and [[Boc Aseca|Boc]] made a reconaissance flight near [[Fort Nowhere]] on [[Ruusan]] on one such shuttle. They would also be used to land troops during the [[Battle of Fort Nowhere|ensuing battle]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>
